test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is** : broaden.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"broaden your horizons" **is a common idiom meaning to expand your understanding, knowledge, or experiences.
 
• **"Broaden your horizons"** is often used in the context of travel, learning, and personal development.
 
• An **example **of using** "broaden your horizons"** in a sentence could be: "Studying abroad can help students broaden their horizons and learn about new cultures."

Therefore, the phrase that fits the context of the sentence and completes the idiom correctly is **"broaden your horizons."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Idioms are fixed expressions with a figurative meaning.
 
• "Constrict" means to make narrower, typically a physical space, so it does not fit contextually with horizons in this phrase.
 
• "Localise" means to make something local or restricted to a particular place, which is opposite to the idea of expanding experiences and knowledge.
 
• "Contract" generally means to decrease in size, number, or range, which is also the opposite of what is intended in the context of the sentence.
